sentences.en: I will penalize you if you do not observe these regulations.
sentences.zh: 如果你不遵守这些规定，我会给你惩罚。

sentences.en: If you do not observe these regulations, you will be penalized.

sentences.en: Women get penalized for being assertive at work.
sentences.zh: 女性因为工作中的表现力强而处于不利地位。

senses.zh: 对…予以惩罚,使处于不利地位
